g.text: Every system a part of the library made, grouped by the part: which parts the estate leans on, which products share them (the names say the product), and what a change to one part would touch. The lines are the interfaces between
them, faded, so the same pattern shows on every product. A system written by hand has no part and is not here; the parts page of the library says the same from the other side.
